0	[Music]	[Música]
1	This week's Torah portion, Parashat Balak. This week
2	marks the yahrzeit of Rabbeinu the Or HaChaim HaKadosh.
3	Not many of the great sages of Israel are called by the title
4	"the Holy."
5	The Or HaChaim HaKadosh
6	was a great Kabbalist,
7	and on the other hand he was also an immense Torah genius. He
8	combined Pshat and Kabbalah.
9	Sadly, he passed away at the age of 47. Very young.
10	But in his lifetime he managed to write many, many
11	books.
12	The most famous book is the Or HaChaim HaKadosh
13	on the Torah,
14	but he has other books as well. He has a book called Peri
15	To'ar. Peri To'ar is a large, deep and very powerful book
16	on the laws of forbidden and permitted: Shulchan Arukh,
17	Yoreh De'ah. He has a book, Rishon LeTzion.
18	Rishon LeTzion, on some of the tractates of the Shas, with
19	immense and wonderful analyses.
20	He also has the book Chefetz HaShem, on the tractates of the Shas,
21	in both halakhah and aggadah.
22	Many, many very important books, but
23	the book that all of Israel loves to study is the Or
24	HaChaim HaKadosh. The Or HaChaim is a book that investigates
25	and expounds the wording of the verses, to understand also ideas
26	of Mussar, there are lofty ideas of Mussar in this book, and on the other hand there is
27	also much halakhah and much analysis
28	of Torah law, a great and wondrous book.
29	I heard from my father, my teacher, Maran Rabbeinu Ovadia Yosef, of
30	blessed memory, a righteous and holy man,
31	that anyone who suffers from an eye ailment
32	should study the Or HaChaim HaKadosh.
33	Reading the Or HaChaim HaKadosh sanctifies
34	the eyes and also heals them. And my father told me
35	that when he was ill and suffered from eye pains, he studied
36	the Or HaChaim on the Parashah and he became healthy. This is
37	a segulah. That is to say, the Or HaChaim HaKadosh was entirely
38	holy, and his books too are full of holiness.
39	By his light we will walk, and his merit will protect us. Amen. May it be
40	His will.
41	[Applause]
